title: impl verify runs the suite about 40% slower than running it directly
desc: WB-49's impl verify failed three times on test_budget.OpeningCommands.test_status_is_instant (0.766s, 0.773s, 0.777s against a 0.75s budget). The same suite on the same tree passes when run directly: 1090 tests in 138s, against about 194s under impl verify with the same command and PYTHONPATH=lib. On main, 1056 tests pass in 138s directly; WB-48's verify took 94s earlier the same day. verify._execute passes os.environ plus the declared env and captures output. Find what makes the suite slower under verify, and whether the timing budget or the runner is at fault.
